event_rule: all successful primary OFZ-PD auction results; no demand score, no bid-to-cover filter

selection.control_rule: nearest positive prior duration_days then security_id; exclude all issues auctioned in this publication day

evaluation.decision_at: max printed result availability and midnight Moscow following publication day
evaluation.entry: first global factual TQOB session strictly after publication day; no price-dependent retry
evaluation.exit: global factual session five sessions after entry; no price-dependent retry
evaluation.unit_of_summary: equal mean within publication day, then equal mean across days
evaluation.unresolved: retain all selected events in coverage; complete-case price statistics clearly labelled; no imputed NAV

limitations: current-vintage auction pages with conservative timing, not original publication vintages
clean-price event return omits accrued-interest cashflows, coupons, settlement, funding and tax
control is diagnostic, not a short position; borrow and short costs are not modeled
same-day observations are clustered; overlapping five-session windows still dependent
daily OPEN and percentage costs are research proxies, not executable BID/OFFER
no CAGR, Sharpe, MDD or 20/50 percent claim from overlapping event returns
no post-outcome sign, horizon, liquidity, duration-distance or universe tuning
